accessibility.description: WolfAccess speaks menus, settings, save slots, pop-ups, subtitles with optional speaker names and dialogue choices through NVDA, JAWS or Narrator. A scanner lists nearby things and characters with distance and actions, and can walk Bigby to them. It also covers zones, close-ups, location choices, fight guidance with sounds, mashing prompts and optional audio description of scenes. It works with a keyboard or an Xbox-style controller and follows the game's language, including French, Spanish, German, Italian and Polish, plus Russian with a fan translation. It supports Windows only.
